payload.note: Tropical residual-gradient checkpoint: on every fixed connected regular graph and every nonconstant power ray Omega_x=t^(a_x), the maximal edge-jump DAG gives ||r||^2~t^(2D) sum c_x^2 and ||grad A||^2~t^(4D) sum d_x^2 with sum d_x^2>0. A weighted-face compactness argument covers every unbounded fixed-graph sequence. Combined with the unique-vacuum and bilaplacian vacuum limits, this proves a positive graph-dependent Polyak-Lojasiewicz constant. It rules out fixed-volume boundary escape, but no L-uniform lower bound for c_L/omega_L^2, Witten/Lyapunov transfer, actual interacting H^-1 moment, continuum, Born, Krein, or Lorentzian theorem is established. The live negative branch must be genuinely growing-volume and multiscale.
